name: ASYMMETRIC_INEQUALITY_FRAMING
description: Frame the undirected inequality (x != y) as a symmetric strict inequality ("one mode must be strictly greater than the other"). This mathematically perfectly matches x != y, but uses vocabulary that typically triggers directed graph or partial order templates in LLMs, potentially disrupting their standard graph coloring recognition and leading to a flawed or overly complex solver, all while strictly following the expert critique to use a direct rule rather than a derived polynomial.
